name: University of Alberta
header:
University of Alberta
Canada · Mathematics MSc / PhD
QS Mathematics 2026 world rank 102. Included in Canada top ten including the published band crossing tenth place (11
institutions total). Official QS public table verified 5 November 2026; rank bands have no internal ordering.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Do not use the displayed January 15, 2026 date as a 2027 deadline.
• Bachelor route is MSc, not normal direct PhD.
• Reference invitations and document uploads wait until payment/submission.
• International funding figures are gross and only the written offer establishes a guarantee.
• Faculty research fit is verified; willingness to supervise in 2027 is not established.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
UChicago four-year math bachelor qualifies for MSc consideration subject to equivalence, preparation and GPA
≥3.3 over the last two years/60 credits. PhD requires a master’s; bachelor applicants are normally considered
for MSc, with possible later transfer. International applicants accepted. [a] [d]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose thesis MSc; contact potential supervisors if useful, but prior agreement is not mandatory. Prepare
documents, obtain referee consent, submit and pay early: portal document uploads and reference invitations
activate after submission/payment. [c] [h] [g]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Encouraged but not mandatory before applying; department can match incoming student with supervisor.
Confirm 2027 availability with faculty. [c] [a]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
New Graduate Admissions Portal/Slate: submit/pay before uploads. Checklist tracking and reference
management available; consult current portal rather than obsolete GSMS upload limits. [g] [h]
Cycle verification [Unresolved]
No explicit Fall 2027 department date found after targeted official searches; requirements are standing unless
marked prior-cycle. [b] [c] [d]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Prior cycle]
Fall 2027 date not established. The currently visible department banner explicitly says Fall 2026: January 15,
2026. Do not relabel it 2027. Normal entry is September; January entry exceptional. [c] [b]
Funding consideration [Unresolved]
No separately dated Fall 2027 funding deadline established. Complete admissions files are reviewed
progressively from January and places may fill before the stated close. [c] [j]
Reference receipt [Prior cycle]
All letters must reach the department by its application deadline; the published January 15, 2026 date is
prior-cycle only. Confirm 2027 date. [c]

Test-score receipt [Standing rule]
Required official English scores must be received before review; submit the application first, then order scores
and allow 3-5 business days for matching. Confirm current department cutoff; UChicago degree exemption
should apply. [g] [f]
Supporting documents [Unresolved]
All supporting documents share the departmental deadline; late materials are not considered under the posted
department policy. No separate 2027 document date verified. [c]
Accepting an offer [Standing rule]
Usually within 30 days of offer; the offer letter controls. No universal April 15 commitment date stated. [c]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
If not exempt: IELTS 7.0 overall/6.0 each; TOEFL before 21 January 2026: 100/22 each, from that date: 5.0/4.5
each; PTE 68/60 each; Cambridge 176/169 each. Scores within two years. Department standards supersede
lower central minima. [d] [e]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed English-instruction UChicago degree falls within the recognized United States credential
exemption; F-1 citizenship/status is not the deciding factor. Confirm how an in-progress degree is recorded if
applying before graduation. [f] [e]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional; department permits uploading existing scores. Not required. [d] [c]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional; program directory explicitly labels GRE general and mathematics subject scores optional. [d]

sections.text:
Transcripts and degree records [Standing rule]
Upload complete front/back transcript scans for every postsecondary institution, including incomplete,
exchange and transfer-credit study; show current enrollment and grading key. Degree certificates where
applicable; certified English translations unless accepted Canadian French records. Institution-sent official
records follow an offer. [b] [g]
Mathematics-course list [Standing rule]
No separate mathematics-course inventory appears on the published checklist; courses and grades must
appear in transcripts. Confirm any portal-specific request. [b] [d]
Course descriptions [Unresolved]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
Three references; provide institutional email addresses. Letters on letterhead; central policy treats letters as
valid for one year. [b] [k]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
Admission letters may be used for scholarship evaluation. No extra reference stated for automatic
departmental entrance consideration; separately applied awards can differ. [k] [a]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
Secure invitation is sent only after application submission AND payment, not merely when referee details are
entered. [h]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes: invitations depend on submitting and paying first. [h]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Portal checklist distinguishes Awaiting (red X) and Received (green check); monitor reference checklist and use
reminders. [g]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
Recommendations page permits editing referee details, reminders, adding/excluding referees even after a
letter arrives. Central policy: validity one year; automatic reuse or referee revision of an already submitted
letter not established. [g] [k]

sections.title: Written materials
sections.text:
Academic CV / resume [Standing rule]
Required prescribed one-page CV form; it allows reverse-side continuation for employment, honors and
publications. Includes languages, specialization, faculty contacts and three referee names/positions. Upload
completed form. [i] [b]
Statement of purpose [Standing rule]
No separate SOP listed; the required personal statement serves the purpose below. [b] [d]
Personal / background statement [Standing rule]
Required 1-2 pages, maximum two. Faithful prompt summary: explain academic background,
mathematics/statistics interest and future plans. Font, margins and word limit not published. Linked detailed
prompt PDF was unavailable. [b] [d]
Research-interest statement [Standing rule]
Include intended specialty and research interests within CV/personal statement. No separate research-interest
essay listed. [i] [b]
Research proposal [Unresolved]
No separate research proposal listed for mathematics admission; portal may request program-specific
documents. [b] [d] [g]
Writing sample / thesis / research summary [Standing rule]
No thesis/writing-sample requirement listed; optional papers are permitted as below. [d]
Publications list [Standing rule]
Publications appear on CV; up to three publications may additionally be supplied, optional. Public instructions
do not settle whether links replace upload or file formatting. [i] [d]
Course-list document [Unresolved]
No separate written course-list requirement found beyond transcript. [b] [d]
Scholarship essays [Unresolved]
No extra essay stated for automatic departmental entrance scholarships; external awards have their own
forms and eligibility. Current 2027 award prompts not established. [a] [j]
Other short answers / materials [Standing rule]
Central GPS expressly prohibits generative-AI-assisted writing in application materials. This matters before
drafting statements or samples. No separate background/diversity essay listed. [h] [b]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Posted domestic thesis minimum: MSc CAD 28,366/year, PhD CAD 29,481/year. International package adds
approximately CAD 4,500 annually for part of differential tuition: arithmetic estimates CAD 32,866 and CAD
33,981, not separately quoted guarantees. Tuition/fees remain payable. [j]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc up to two years; PhD up to four, possible fifth-year application without guarantee. Course-based programs
normally unfunded. [j]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International thesis students eligible. Guarantee exists only if explicitly included in offer; some
externally/home-country-sponsored students receive no departmental guarantee. [j]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Package combines awards, GTA and research support. Typical GTA workload 12 hours/week for a 16-week
term; summer research money normally from supervisor. Exact offer and progress/appointment conditions
govern. [j] [z]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Incoming GTA consideration needs no separate application; exceptional entrants can be
department-nominated for entrance awards. [j] [a]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department entrance scholarships, Josephine Mitchell awards and prize, summer research/marking, university
competitions and eligibility-dependent external awards. Department page still mentions Vanier; verify current
competition rather than assume that legacy scheme remains open. [j] [a]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 135 nonrefundable, nontransferable per application, paid online with Visa/Mastercard credit card.
Third-party payment possible; debit/prepaid and transfer services not accepted. [g]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
GPS says fee mandatory and no waivers on request. No mathematics-specific waiver found. [g]

sections.text:

Curves on surfaces, K3 surfaces and complex projective geometry. Official directory confirms algebraic
geometry; recent author-paper metadata checks current topic. [l] [x] [y]

Paper metadata on the cited official research page supports the stated research fit.

Hodge theory, K3 and Calabi-Yau geometry, mirror symmetry and Landau-Ginzburg models. [l] [m]

activate after submission/payment. [c] [h] [g]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Posted domestic thesis minimum: MSc CAD 28,366/year, PhD CAD 29,481/year. International package adds
approximately CAD 4,500 annually for part of differential tuition: arithmetic estimates CAD 32,866 and CAD
33,981, not separately quoted guarantees. Tuition/fees remain payable. [j]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc up to two years; PhD up to four, possible fifth-year application without guarantee. Course-based programs
normally unfunded. [j]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International thesis students eligible. Guarantee exists only if explicitly included in offer; some
externally/home-country-sponsored students receive no departmental guarantee. [j]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Package combines awards, GTA and research support. Typical GTA workload 12 hours/week for a 16-week
term; summer research money normally from supervisor. Exact offer and progress/appointment conditions
govern. [j] [z]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Incoming GTA consideration needs no separate application; exceptional entrants can be
department-nominated for entrance awards. [j] [a]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Department entrance scholarships, Josephine Mitchell awards and prize, summer research/marking, university
competitions and eligibility-dependent external awards. Department page still mentions Vanier; verify current
competition rather than assume that legacy scheme remains open. [j] [a]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 135 nonrefundable, nontransferable per application, paid online with Visa/Mastercard credit card.
Third-party payment possible; debit/prepaid and transfer services not accepted. [g]

GPS says fee mandatory and no waivers on request. No mathematics-specific waiver found. [g]

Funding and fees
Amount and coverage [Standing rule]
Posted domestic thesis minimum: MSc CAD 28,366/year, PhD CAD 29,481/year. International package adds
approximately CAD 4,500 annually for part of differential tuition: arithmetic estimates CAD 32,866 and CAD
33,981, not separately quoted guarantees. Tuition/fees remain payable. [j]
Years of support [Standing rule]
MSc up to two years; PhD up to four, possible fifth-year application without guarantee. Course-based programs
normally unfunded. [j]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International thesis students eligible. Guarantee exists only if explicitly included in offer; some
externally/home-country-sponsored students receive no departmental guarantee. [j]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Package combines awards, GTA and research support. Typical GTA workload 12 hours/week for a 16-week

govern. [j] [z]

Incoming GTA consideration needs no separate application; exceptional entrants can be
